name: Financial Services
tagline: Compress KYC, underwriting, and ops reviews with auditable agent workflows.
overview: Banks and fintechs still rely on analysts for document-heavy KYC, credit memos, and exception handling. Agentic systems can draft decisions with full audit trails while humans retain final authority.
painPoints: KYC/AML reviews bottlenecked by document chasing
Credit memo preparation takes days of analyst time
Ops exceptions pile up across disconnected core systems
strategicImpact: 50% less analyst time on first-draft credit memos
Lower false-positive alert fatigue in AML queues

singleAgents.name: KYC Packet Assembler
singleAgents.role: Collects, validates, and structures onboarding documents
singleAgents.output: Complete KYC dossier with exception flags

singleAgents.name: Credit Memo Drafter
singleAgents.role: Builds first-pass underwriting narratives from structured + unstructured data

singleAgents.name: AML Alert Triage Agent
singleAgents.role: Ranks alerts and drafts investigation narratives
singleAgents.roi: 30% reduction in low-value alert handling time

singleAgents.name: Ops Exception Resolver
singleAgents.role: Diagnoses failed payments and proposes remediation
singleAgents.output: Remediation plan or auto-retry when policy allows

multiAgent.name: Commercial Lending Desk
multiAgent.description: A supervised agent team that moves a commercial loan from intake to credit committee package.

supervisor.name: Lending Desk Supervisor
supervisor.responsibilities: Owns deal status, enforces credit policy gates, and decides when human underwriters must intervene.
supervisor.routingLogic: Intake → Document Agent; financials ready → Spreading Agent; risk signals → Policy Agent; package complete → Memo Agent.

multiAgent.conflictResolution: Policy exceptions always require human approval; conflicting financial extracts trigger dual-source reconciliation; model confidence below threshold freezes progression.

workflow.label: Input
workflow.description: Capture application, entity graph, and uploaded financial documents.

workflow.label: Reason
workflow.description: Supervisor builds a deal plan, risk hypotheses, and required evidence list.

workflow.label: Tool Execution
workflow.description: Specialists extract, spread, screen, and draft using approved banking tools.

workflow.label: Human-in-the-Loop
workflow.description: Underwriter reviews exceptions, edits memo, and signs off for committee.

workflow.label: Output
workflow.description: Committee package published; decision logged with full agent audit trail.
